annotations.title: Move a scheduled run to a new time

description: MOVE a single occurrence of a scheduled/recurring campaign to a new date/time, leaving every other occurrence untouched (e.g. 'push this Tuesday's send to Wednesday'). Pass `runAt` (the existing occurrence from gambot_list_scheduled_runs, matched to the minute) and `newRunAt` (the new datetime). The campaign's timezone is preserved.

runAt.description: Existing occurrence to move (ISO-8601, from gambot_list_scheduled_runs).

name: gambot_reschedule_scheduled_run
title: Move a scheduled run to a new time
